title: Rainier
logline: A can of Rainier on the dock planks, sweating in the sun. Gully's hand setting a second one beside it. Wood's boot at the frame edge. The dock sequence begins with the beer.

panels.composition: Dock planks in August sun, close. One can of Rainier, sweating. A thick hand in a canvas cuff setting a second can beside it. At the page's bottom edge, a boot — Wood's — and the planks' gaps with the bay moving underneath. No faces. The afternoon in the aluminum.

characters.pose: a hand setting down a can
a boot at the frame edge

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of sunlit dock planks with a sweating can of beer and a stocky man's hand in a canvas cuff setting a second can beside it, a boot at the bottom edge of the page, bay water visible through the gaps in the planks, no faces, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The dock sequence opens on the beer.
